thread:
emily (PM): Quick sync  Prospect FinArc wants to pilot but insists on three items before kickoff: tenant limits (per-route quotas), tenant-level telemetry export, and an admin approval step for role changes. They said "all-or-nothing" unless we give a mitigated plan.

raj (ENG): full RBAC + quota engine is big. but we can carve out a "pilot hardening" bundle: enforce per-route token quotas (simple rate-limit by tenant), emit tenant metrics to a customer-facing S3 sink, and add an approval hook for membership changes. 

carla (UX): onboarding copy needs to set expectations. call the capability "Pilot hardening" and show a checklist during setup. Minimal modal for admin approvals is fine.

dave (SRE): telemetry export: we can stream aggregated metrics to S3/CloudWatch in a compact format. Handoff to the customer's SIEM is v1. Retention & long-term archival later.

nina (AE): FinArc will sign if we commit to a delivery window and non-blocking rollback. They want a demo within 7 business days.

emily (PM): option A: delay public MVP to include quota + telemetry + admin console. Option B: ship MVP as-is, but support FinArc via a feature-flagged "pilot hardening" path and a timeboxed delivery for full admin console in v1. Vote?

raj (ENG): vote B. we avoid a global slip. pilot path should be feature-flagged per-tenant and run on Dedicated staging for the first tenant. estimate: 6 engineer-days to wire quota + export + approval hook.

carla (UX): B works. I'll draft the banner and the small modal for manual approval flows. also add the checklist UI so sales can prove acceptance.

dave (SRE): B ok if we add per-tenant rollback toggle and export health checks. I'll own the runbook and alerts.

emily (PM): consensus = B. action items: 
 - emily: draft amendment with delivery window (max 60 days) + demo acceptance criteria (today)
 - raj: implement tenant quota + export + approval hook, PR in 6 working days
 - dave: S3 export pipeline + runbook + rollback toggle (5 working days)
 - carla: onboarding banner + approval modal mock (3 working days)
 - nina: secure verbal OK and get legal sign-off (EOD)

ci-bot: deploy 2167894500 -> staging/product :success: 

raj (ENG): PR opened draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tenant-guard/pull/9. Quota proto + feature flag added.

nina (AE): FinArc gave verbal OK to pilot path. Legal wants the 60-day window in writing; I'll push.

carla (UX): mock uploaded to product doc. Banner text: "Pilot hardening enabled: limited admin features and export only for pilot tenants."

dave (SRE): export tested to s3://finarc-pilot-metrics (retention 30d). alerts wired to #eng-oncall. rollback toggle implemented behind flag.

emily (PM): acceptance criteria for FinArc demo:
1) Tenant quota enforced for route /generate with configured QPS limits;
2) Tenant metrics export delivers per-minute aggregates to customer S3;
3) Admin approval modal records and signs membership changes;
4) Feature-flag per-tenant and rollback toggle operational.

nina (AE): legal signed amendment. demo scheduled Day 5.

raj (ENG): merging PR after tests pass. Will canary on Dedicated staging for FinArc only.

ci-bot: deploy 2167894800 -> canary/finarc :success: 

emily (PM): closing: MVP remains on schedule publicly; FinArc runs on a feature-flagged pilot-hardening path with delivery commitments to v1. Keep updates here and escalate if Day 6 risks occur. Thanks. :thumbsup:

nina (AE): FinArc signed and onboarding in flight. Great job team. :tada:
